decision: Admit limited independently expressed synthesis; source inspection is not efficacy evidence

donors.closure: Only command-discovery and outcome-assertion concepts selected. JS/TS testing-patterns and browser DevTools are not dependencies of the synthesis; no framework examples imported.
donors.compatibility: Portable design guidance; no runtime, framework, shell command or host dependency added. Existing loader retained.
donors.rejected: Mandatory TDD execution, blanket full-suite runs, delete-existing-code prescriptions, automatic follow-on skill invocation.
donors.core_gap: Existing Core Workflow step 2 inspects stack and Rules require explicit assertions; lacks command-source recording and distinction between observable outcome and internal call sequence.
donors.displaced_clause: None; extend existing Workflow step 2/3 and Rules without removing four modes or review contract.
